PART V  Medical Nutrition Therapy
Sodium
Evidence from a variety of studies supports lowering blood 
pressure and CVD risk by reducing dietary sodium. For exam-
ple, in the Trials of Hypertension Prevention more than 2400 
individuals with moderately elevated blood pressure were as-
signed randomly to either cut their sodium by 750 to 1000 mg 
per day or to follow general guidelines for healthy eating for
